description: List the replies the user sent to messages from Moneda, newest first: text, the message title, and the attached document's name if any. Returns up to `limit` items (default 20, max 50) with a `nextCursor` for pagination.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: id of the last seen reply.

limit.description: Number of replies to return (default 20, max 50).

name: list_message_replies
